name: Firespitter Whelp
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever you cast a noncreature or Dragon spell, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you cast a noncreature or Dragon spell, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.

needs.what: an `any_of` disjunction inside a trigger's `filter`, so a `spell_cast` trigger can match a spell that is EITHER noncreature (`not_types: ["Creature"]`) OR has subtype Dragon (`subtypes: ["Dragon"]`), firing once per spell
needs.why_existing_wont_do: TRIGGER_FILTER_KEYS (engine/triggers.py) has no `any_of`, and validate_trigger_filter refuses it; every listed key is ANDed, so one filter can say only 'noncreature Dragon spell'. `any_types` is an or over card types alone and cannot reach a subtype. Two separate spell_cast triggers (one noncreature, one Dragon) would deal 2 damage for a noncreature Dragon spell (a Kindred Dragon instant or sorcery), which is a different card. The selector and static-filter `any_of` already exists (characteristics._matches_printed, selectors.py), so the trigger-side matcher only needs to recurse the same way
